# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the m152 renderer and early Graphite-era API work for the next release line. This preview blends the Skia m152 engine update with new Graphite GPU bindings, async pixel-read APIs, Vulkan packaging work, and a cluster of leak and performance fixes in core managed paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **The preview line moved to Skia milestone m152** — SkiaSharp 4.152.0 brings in the Chrome m152 engine update while also carrying forward the final m151 bug-fix syncs that landed immediately before the branch advanced. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU bindings arrived for the next generation backend** — The preview adds managed bindings for Graphite on Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, giving early adopters access to Skia's newer GPU architecture alongside the existing Ganesh surface. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel reads became backend-neutral** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels APIs that let callers request asynchronous readback without committing to a specific GPU backend implementation. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan packaging expanded beyond the core binding** — A SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package now ships alongside the validation work that runs Vulkan tests on Android and Linux, making the Vulkan integration story easier to consume across ecosystems. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Several native lifetime bugs were eliminated** — The preview fixes use-after-free issues in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap subset helpers, and also closes a CoTaskMem leak in the raster-failure path for SKImage.Create. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Windows native builds became more reliable** — Native Windows builds now initialize the MSVC environment once per build, and the release line stops pinning a specific Windows SDK version by default. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Several managed hot paths now do less work per call** — SKData.SaveTo avoids an extra buffer copy, HandleDictionary caches its reflection-based registration check, encoded-text parsing skips an intermediate string, and runtime-effect uniforms start with a right-sized lookup table. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))
- **Binding and solution generation became more deterministic** — The preview tightens up generated bindings across platforms and standardizes solution files on .slnx, helping keep generated output stable across environments. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528), [#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Platform

- **Container and server-oriented environments received more first-class coverage** — The line adds containerized validation legs for Azure Linux, Alpine and Nano Server, and uses FreeType to improve font availability on Nano Server deployments. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships inside this preview line unchanged at the API level, while the shared release train keeps the surrounding text and build infrastructure ready for the next stable release.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the 4.152 line with the Skia m152 update, the new Graphite bindings, backend-neutral async pixel reads, Vulkan packaging additions, and a wide pass of leak, performance and build-determinism fixes.
